_readme: THE ONLY FILE A COLLEGE EDITS.
Everything below is served to the interface by GET /api/v1/institution, so
whatever is written here is exactly what appears on screen. Change a value,
press 'Reload from disk' on the administrator's Setup screen (or call
POST /api/v1/admin/institution/reload) and the running server picks it up -
no rebuild, no restart, no code change.
A partial file is valid. Delete any key you do not need and the built-in
default is used; the defaults live in backend/app/core/institution.py and
The values below are the demo deployment (Crystal Institute of Technology).
Replace them with your own institution before running this in front of your
Keys beginning with an underscore are comments and are ignored by the loader.
